plan.analysis: Inclusion is catastrophic (recall 0.123): 146/179 misses are in the smallest tertile (recall 0.027), median missed size 37px vs 90px train median, mostly faint thin dark vertical streaks/clusters. Patches (recall 0.65) and scratches (0.58) also fail on small instances (low tertile recall ~0.42, missed medians 52px and 42px vs larger train medians). So the dominant gap is small-defect detection in all classes, worst for inclusion.
plan.rationale: Give the worst class (inclusion) the largest share and paste at small scales (0.30-0.75, prefer_small) to match the 37px missed streaks, using the thin dark streak/cluster sources that visually match the misses. Patches and scratches get moderate budgets at small-mid scales (0.40-1.00, prefer_small) targeting their small-blob/small-line misses; patch sources restricted to blob-like shapes (excluding streak-like 136/23/13/103/20/62) to avoid class confusion, scratch sources left as all with prefer_small to bias toward thin lines. Same-class backgrounds keep pastes realistic; all classes stay >=10.
